name: study-session-root
description: Root orchestrator for StudyAI frontend and backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix FrontEnd && npm install --prefix BackEnd
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix FrontEnd && npm install --prefix BackEnd --omit=dev && npm run prisma:generate --prefix BackEnd && npm run build --prefix FrontEnd -- --outDir ../dist
